name: Weighted utility grips
description: Chunky rubber handles that slide onto forks, pens and toothbrushes so they are easier to hold when your hands are sore or weak.

name: Handheld lighted magnifier
description: A magnifying glass with a built-in light. Helps with small print on labels, menus and mail.

name: Noise-reducing earplugs
description: Reusable earplugs that turn the volume of a room down without blocking it out, for places that feel too loud or too busy.

name: Talking pill reminder box
description: A pill box that says out loud which compartment to open and when, so you do not have to keep track yourself.

name: Folding reacher grabber
description: A long arm with a trigger and a gripper on the end, for picking things up off the floor or off a high shelf without bending or climbing.
